Aphrodite A1: Match Made In Heaven Once per game, Aphrodite may change the format. Pre-Merge: In the realms that are holding a sacrifice, everyone must pick a player to "couple" with - if that person picks them back, they form a couple. If two people form a couple and vote differently, both their votes do not count. Anyone who does not find a couple has incoming votes on them multiplied by 2 during the sacrifice, but can vote normally. Aphrodite may force up to one couple in each realm to form, which is announced to the players in that realm. Merge: Only usable when an odd number of players are alive. Everyone must pick a player to form a "couple" with - if that person picks them back, they are both immune for the round. If only one person remains uncoupled, they are instantly eliminated, otherwise, everyone in a couple votes on someone who isn't, and the player with the most votes is eliminated. In addition, Aphrodite gets to choose what up to half (rounded down) of the possible couples will be, and these are announced to everyone. A2: Twisted Desire Twice per game, Aphrodite may pick another Herald to "charm" for one round. While they are charmed, she gains full control of their abilities and vote, and can steal any of their passives for herself in the exact state that they were for the Herald she charmed; however, she is not told what patron or abilities her target has, and if she tries to use or steal an ability that her target doesn't have, they become un-charmed. So, everyone gets together in one big chat and couples up with someone from another tribe. Odd one will be left out like in Eradication but not immediately killed.
